goal: GAP SWEEP (wave 5b): every listed depth_target is currently not_simulated/config_only in the shipped console. Build each one on a REAL backend (Nano + offline) and lift its capability level to full or limited. 'Out of Vyomi's scope', 'separate product', 'single-account' or 'not modeled' are NOT acceptable reasons: model it in the shared core (Python core/*_core.py, vendored to wasm), wire it through the native wire, enforce behaviour (not stored config), and make the console section live. Only leave a target not_simulated if it needs something physically impossible in a local simulator (real external hardware, real money, a real third-party service) — and then write that concrete reason. config_only targets must become enforced (the setting changes observable behaviour). Update core/capabilities, tests/conformance, ui-spec mapping and smoke where relevant.
note: WAVE 5b gap sweep (orchestrator). Approved by the user: finish all the gaps with real backends.

depth_targets.title: Redundancy (replication SKU)
depth_targets.current_reason: The SKU name round-trips through ARM; Vyomi stores data once, locally — there is no secondary region, no geo-replication and no customer-managed failover to enforce against.

depth_targets.title: Encryption (key source)
depth_targets.current_reason: The encryption.keySource flag round-trips through ARM for display only; every account is encrypted the same way underneath. Customer-managed keys, encryption scopes and infrastructure (double) encryption are not simulated.

depth_targets.title: Data protection (soft delete, point-in-time restore, versioning, change feed) over the blobServices/default ARM sub-resource
depth_targets.current_reason: deleteRetentionPolicy, containerDeleteRetentionPolicy, restorePolicy, isVersioningEnabled and changeFeed round-trip through ARM exactly as configured, but core/azure_blob_core.py does not enforce any of them: deleted blobs/containers are not recoverable, there are no blob versions, and there is no change feed to read. Operational backup, permanent-delete and file-share soft delete are not simulate

depth_targets.title: Diagnose and solve problems
depth_targets.current_reason: A guided troubleshooting wizard backed by Azure's own telemetry and knowledge base — there is no equivalent diagnostic corpus in Vyomi.
depth_targets.hint: telemetry: emit real metrics/logs from the simulated engine (wave-6 Prometheus/OTel are the offline sinks once landed; until then derive real series from actual API activity in the core) — never synthetic random data

depth_targets.title: Access control (IAM) scoped to a storage account
depth_targets.current_reason: Vyomi's RBAC simulation (core/azure_iam_core.py) is not wired to a per-resource scope check from this console; role assignments, deny assignments and the 'Check access' simulator are not rendered here.

depth_targets.title: Data migration (AzCopy / Data Box / migration tooling)
depth_targets.current_reason: A separate migration toolchain and, for Data Box, physical hardware shipped by Microsoft — outside what a local simulator can run.

depth_targets.title: Events (Event Grid subscriptions on storage events)
depth_targets.current_reason: Storage-account-sourced Event Grid event subscriptions are not wired from this console; core/azure_eventgrid_core.py models Event Grid topics, not storage-account system events.

depth_targets.title: Storage Mover
depth_targets.current_reason: A separate Azure product (Microsoft.StorageMover) for migrating file shares from on-premises servers — not modelled by any Vyomi core.

depth_targets.title: File shares (Azure Files)
depth_targets.current_reason: Azure Files is a distinct SMB/NFS data plane (account.file.core.windows.net) with no core in this repo yet — not yet implemented.

depth_targets.title: Front Door and CDN
depth_targets.current_reason: A separate edge/CDN product fronting the storage endpoint — outside a local simulator's network topology.

depth_targets.title: Object replication
depth_targets.current_reason: Requires a second storage account and cross-account async replication; Vyomi stores each account's blobs independently with nothing to replicate between them.

depth_targets.title: Blob inventory
depth_targets.current_reason: A scheduled background job that writes an inventory report blob — Vyomi has no job scheduler wired to the Blob core.

depth_targets.title: Azure AI Search (index this storage account)
depth_targets.current_reason: A separate Azure product (search indexing + a query engine) — not modelled by any Vyomi core.

depth_targets.title: Data Lake Gen2 upgrade
depth_targets.current_reason: A one-way, backend-run upgrade of the account's namespace flag plus a full-container metadata rewrite — there is no equivalent background migration job in Vyomi.

depth_targets.title: Advisor recommendations
depth_targets.current_reason: Azure Advisor's recommendations come from analysing real usage telemetry and cost data across Microsoft's fleet — there is no equivalent analytics pipeline in Vyomi.
